messages.subject: Biometrician Position with Alaska Department of Fish and Game
parts:
The Alaska Department of Fish and Game, Division of Wildlife Conservation is recruiting for a Biometrician to be stationed in Palmer, AK.  The posting can be found at https://www.governmentjobs.com/careers/alaska/jobs/1628157/biometrician-i-ii-iii-pcn-11-2293

Questions about the position should be directed to Mark Burch (mark....@alaska.gov) or Michael Guttery (michael...@alaska.gov).
